cache_decision.reason: Existing warm-cache behavior validated, not a new cold indexing optimization. Source and cache key/checksum hashes serve distinct integrity requirements; cache v3 uses a binary DTO and does not use Zstd. DTO cloning identified as potential overhead without a proven candidate, so no production change retained.

filtering_decision.reason: No new safe high-value category demonstrated. Module-only files may still carry references, docs, value flow, or provider facts. YAML/TOML and Markdown already bypass Python/Rust/TypeScript scope collectors; filtering them could change committed documentation/configuration facts.

leaf_guard_decision: Rejected. Favorable raw end-to-end medians are not sufficient attribution: user CPU increased in pair2, average CPU utilization increased in every pair, and two alternating per-file screens show the guarded balanced traversal slower by4.44percent and5.89percent. Strict original CPU-load objective is not met. Restore production rather than claim host variation as an optimization.
limitations: Contemporary cold baseline wall12.33..14.45seconds and user42.38..46.12seconds indicate host variability; historical10.5..11second absolute timing is not re-established. No outlier removed.
Query screen covers non-trivial .py files, not .pyi stubs or other languages; it is a rejection screen, not proof of a replacement extractor.

One incomplete harness attempt failed before emitting timed measurements because inventory initially lacked linked-workspace mapping; the full three-pair batch restarted after fixing this. All3990 inventory sources subsequently resolved using gridviewspec and traverse roots.
query_decision: Rejected before production integration. Reused precompiled wildcard query cursor preserves entry order on screened non-trivial .py files but costs2.90..2.96times the balanced manual walk even without reconstructing exits. Existing empty/comment-only fast path is excluded. Empty-root query difference retained separately. This is an optimistic screening comparison, not a production semantic-parity claim for a query-based extractor.
